name: Ocean's Echo
summary: Although many merfolk claim deep connections to both art and the natural world, a rare few merfolk can manipulate the forces of nature and weave them into song.
replacesText: Mystery Bonus Skills; 4th, 8th, 10th, 12th, 14th-level Bonus Spells; 1st, 3rd, 15th-level Revelation

features.name: Class Skills
features.summary: An ocean’s echo adds Bluff, Intimidate, Knowledge (nature), and Perform to her list of class skills. These replace the additional class skills from her mystery.

features.name: Bonus Spells
features.summary: Sound burst (4th), shout (8th), song of discord (10th), greater shout (12th), and pied piping APG (14th). These bonus spells replace the oracle’s mystery bonus spells at these levels.

features.name: Inspiring Song (Ex)
features.summary: The voice of an ocean’s echo provides inspiration to allies. This ability is identical to bardic performance (using Perform [sing] only), allowing her to inspire courage at 1st level, inspire competence at 3rd level, and inspire heroics at 15th level, as a bard of the ocean’s echo’s level. It is usable a total number of rounds per day equal to her level + her Charisma modifier (minimum 1). This ability replaces the revelations gained at 1st, 3rd, and 15th level.

features.name: Recommended Mysteries
features.summary: Ancestor UM , heavens, life, lore, nature, time UM , waves, wind.
